topic: 5 beginner mistakes with Claude Cowork (and the safe habit for each)
post:
Claude Cowork can work with your files and apps. 🗂️
That's exactly why these 5 beginner mistakes matter.

Straight from Claude's own safety guide, here's what to avoid, and what to do instead:

1️⃣ Giving access to everything
✅ Make a dedicated working folder and share only that.

2️⃣ Sharing sensitive files
✅ Keep financial documents, passwords and personal records out unless you truly need them.

3️⃣ Scheduling risky actions
✅ Don't schedule tasks that send messages, make purchases, or do anything hard to undo.

4️⃣ Letting it browse any website
✅ Only allow sites you trust. Web pages can hide instructions meant to trick AI. That's called "prompt injection."

5️⃣ Not watching what it does
✅ Look out for anything unexpected, like files or sites you never mentioned. For sensitive work, approve each step yourself.

Why it matters:
AI that can take actions saves real time. A few simple habits keep you in control while it does.

Which of these habits are you adding first? 👇

First, don't give it access to everything. Make one working folder and share only that. Second, keep sensitive files like finances and passwords out of it.
Third, don't schedule tasks that send messages, make purchases, or do anything that's hard to undo.
Fourth, only let it browse sites you trust. Some web pages hide instructions meant to trick AI. That's called prompt injection.
And fifth, keep an eye on what it does. If it touches files or sites you never mentioned, stop and check. For sensitive work, approve each step yourself.
